endpoint.title: HTTPS FeatureCollection URL
endpoint.description: Public HTTPS host on port 443; redirects, URL credentials, query strings and fragments are refused.

sourceId.title: Stable source ID
sourceId.description: Publisher/product identity, separate from this connection. Changing it requires a new connection.

termsUrl.title: Source terms URL
termsUrl.description: Public HTTPS terms or licence page, reviewed by the operator before use.

coverage.title: Declared coverage
coverage.description: Describe what this result set covers; do not claim completeness without source evidence.

identityProperty.title: Identity property
identityProperty.description: Blank uses GeoJSON feature.id; otherwise a direct properties key. Stable unique IDs are required.

labelProperty.title: Label property
labelProperty.description: Blank displays the stable feature ID.

sourceTimeProperty.title: Source time property
sourceTimeProperty.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant with an explicit UTC offset; blank means unknown.
